summary.going_well: The agent declined to quote rates directly <ref job="SRJ_4RfMzueZyWLb" item="item_5562c2e9-1e5">and deferred pricing to review</ref>. It booked callbacks using the requested time zone and confirmed the result <ref job="SRJ_22rzmjv7yhDe" item="item_4d201ef0-f4f/fnc_0">in the tool call</ref> <ref job="SRJ_22rzmjv7yhDe" item="item_289a578f-e36">and readback</ref>, and passed volunteered purchase details into a loan-officer transfer <ref job="SRJ_LrgBjusTqktP" item="item_2d993505-56d/fnc_0">without re-asking them</ref>.
summary.to_improve: Prioritize the sensitive-data disclosure path and correct the repeated, overbroad refinance claims. Stop inferring states from ambiguous city names, honor requests to defer hardship help, and remove unsupported assessments from intake acknowledgments.

issues.description: When a caller volunteered a street address and began giving an SSN, the agent <ref job="SRJ_RCJdqPex5UiZ" item="item_cdff4931-062">gave only a generic refusal</ref>, omitting the required explanation that neither item is collected at this stage and that the SSN requires later explicit authorization. In another sensitive-data scenario, the agent <ref job="SRJ_mVjkJRXPNVwG" item="item_5cf861d9-3ec">continued intake</ref> rather than giving the safeguard response; the volunteered address/SSN is described in the digest but is not present in the recorded user turn.
issues.suggestion: Trigger the approved SSN and property-address responses whenever either is actually volunteered; do not repeat the data, and continue with city or ZIP only after the disclosures.
issues.label: Privacy handling

issues.description: The agent repeatedly asserted conventional refinancing has <ref job="SRJ_HPeqyLek9dDg" item="item_6684b523-ff2">“no upfront government fees” and no permanent mortgage insurance at 20% equity</ref>, with a similar categorical comparison in <ref job="SRJ_Jpro4N7SybD2" item="item_ccd26df1-556">another refinance conversation</ref>. These unqualified claims may mislead borrowers about loan-specific costs, insurance rules and limits.
issues.suggestion: Replace the canned conventional-refinance advantages with qualified, institution-neutral comparisons; leave fees, insurance treatment and applicable loan limits to the eligibility review or licensed officer.
issues.label: Product accuracy

issues.description: The agent treated a Cleveland purchase as being <ref job="SRJ_9yfowMVrBh2N" item="item_074da9fe-cff">“in Ohio”</ref> and repeated the Ohio service-area assumption <ref job="SRJ_AejF7KDMKFFB" item="item_f756faed-d76">in another run</ref>, although the test context specifies Cleveland, Tennessee. The recorded caller said only “Cleveland,” so the state should not have been inferred.
issues.suggestion: Carry forward an explicitly supplied state or ZIP; if only an ambiguous city is available, ask which state before making a service-area statement.
issues.label: Wrong location

issues.description: After a delinquent borrower said they would look into the offered loan-officer and counseling options <ref job="SRJ_CypZ5a3EtKAS" item="item_cf20e2f7-b69">“later, but not right now”</ref>, the agent <ref job="SRJ_CypZ5a3EtKAS" item="item_365724b5-266">continued intake</ref> and eventually <ref job="SRJ_CypZ5a3EtKAS" item="item_05ac52ec-493">asked for monthly debts</ref>. The same defer-then-question pattern appears <ref job="SRJ_ezot6T7f9HVD" item="item_5c887e22-c51">after another borrower deferred help</ref> <ref job="SRJ_ezot6T7f9HVD" item="item_066e6e4d-7df">before another debt question</ref>.
issues.suggestion: Treat “later, not right now” as a stop signal for hardship intake: acknowledge it, give a concise way to reconnect, and resume questions only if the borrower opts in.
issues.label: Ignored preference

issues.description: Borrower intake frequently includes unsupported assessments: the agent called monthly debt <ref job="SRJ_HPeqyLek9dDg" item="item_8752e379-07d">“very manageable”</ref> and a credit score <ref job="SRJ_aAF6jPMHfNKd" item="item_9cbf6629-95d">“very strong”</ref>. Such judgments can sound like an eligibility assessment before a review.
issues.suggestion: Replace evaluative acknowledgment templates with neutral ones such as “Thanks, I’ve noted that,” and reserve affordability or credit assessments for the review or licensed officer.
issues.label: Unwarranted assessment
